responses.text: You've made the right choice. As long as you're in Freeside, I'm your man. No one will mess with you with me hanging around.
However, once you head over to the Strip or enter the wasteland, I'm heading immediately back here to pick up another customer.
So what do you say? Ready to head out?

topics.prompt: Here's the money. It sounds like I could use a bodyguard.

responses.text: Oh, for the love of - get the hell out of here, then!

topics.prompt: I'd hire you, but I don't have the caps.

responses.text: Are you sure? Well, don't say you weren't warned.

topics.prompt: I don't really think I need a bodyguard.

responses.text: New to Freeside, are you? Trust me, you won't make it ten feet without being accosted by some of our more friendly residents.
I happen to have an understanding with most of the local wildlife, however. With me by your side, they'll kindly find someone else to bother.
So you want to run with the best or not?

topics.prompt: Why would I need a bodyguard in Freeside?

responses.text: You're in luck stranger. You just happen to be talking to the most successful bodyguard in all of Freeside.
And I just happen to be available at the moment. One hundred caps gets you a peaceful, pleasant trip through our fair district. Guaranteed.
Freeside truly is an interesting place, isn't it?
You're either brave or crazy. Either way, I don't care.

topics.prompt: It is, but I think I'll explore it on my own from now on.

responses.text: You'll probably be able to think of a few more before you leave, trust me.

topics.prompt: That's one word for it. Let's keep going.

responses.text: Protection services for hire over here!
You need the best. Hire me!
